# docgx

> Inspect a page / slide for overflowing, overlapping or unreadable text. Reports problems with stable codes and exit codes, and writes an annotated storyboard.

docgx is one of the `gxkit` agent-native review tools. Declare a title and
positioned text blocks; `docgx inspect` measures the rendered page and reports
text that runs off it, covers other text, is too small, or exceeds the word
budget.

## Install

```sh
uvx --from "git+https://github.com/nekomario28/gxkit#subdirectory=packages/docgx" docgx --help
uv tool install ./packages/docgx      # from a clone
```

Needs Python 3.10+ and Pillow.

## Use

```sh
docgx inspect page.py            # report + storyboard, exit 1 on any error
docgx inspect page.py --json
docgx inspect page.py --no-storyboard
docgx render  page.py -o page.png
```

A page file defines `page` (a `Page`) or module-level `TITLE` / `BLOCKS` /
`WIDTH` / `HEIGHT` / `MAX_WORDS`. `x`/`y` are fractions of the page.

A block may also declare the column, or the card, it lives in: `width` / `height`
(fractions of the page). A block with a `width` wraps inside it, and one with a
`height` is reported as `text-overflow` when its measured text is taller than
that box. Declare them on any page that is not one column — without `width` every
block wraps at the page width.

## Checks

error: `clipped-text`, `text-overflow` (out of a declared `width`/`height` box),
  `text-overlap`.
warn: `no-title`, `too-much-text`.
info: `small-text`, `reading-order`, `empty-page`.

Full documentation is in `README.md`.
